name: WA FuelWatch
summary: Western Australian retail fuel prices by suburb, region, brand and fuel type, today's and tomorrow's, from the WA Government's FuelWatch feed.
notes: Free and keyless. The answer is RSS 2.0 XML, not JSON: one item per service station with price, trading name, address and suburb.
One day per request. Today's prices are available around the clock; tomorrow's (Day=tomorrow) only after 2:30pm.
Attribution: FuelWatch must be acknowledged as the source, with a link to www.fuelwatch.wa.gov.au.
Only stations inside the FuelWatch boundaries must report prices; coverage outside them is partial.

endpoints.name: Get fuel prices for a suburb or region
endpoints.summary: Cheapest stations' prices for one fuel type, one day, in a suburb (and its neighbours), a town/shire region or a state region.

Product.description: Fuel type, default 1: 1 unleaded, 2 premium unleaded, 4 diesel, 5 LPG, 6 98 RON, 10 E85, 11 brand diesel.

Region.description: Town/shire region id instead of Suburb, e.g. 25 Metro North of River, 26 Metro South of River, 27 Metro East/Hills, 16 Bunbury, 18 Mandurah, 28 Augusta/Margaret River (full list on the docs page).

StateRegion.description: WA state region: 1 Gascoyne, 2 Goldfields-Esperance, 3 Great Southern, 4 Kimberley, 5 Mid-West, 6 Peel, 7 Pilbara, 8 South-West, 9 Wheatbelt, 98 Metro.

Brand.description: Brand id, e.g. 5 BP, 6 Caltex, 11 Mobil, 14 Shell, 23 United, 29 7-Eleven (full list on the docs page).

notes: Use Suburb or Region, not both. The docs describe the feed as the 10 cheapest prices for the area.
